cards.title: Coffee
cards.text: Roasted on Tuesdays, sold by Friday.
cards.backText: Two house blends and a single origin that changes each month. Ask at the counter for a taste of whatever is on the grinder.

cards.title: Delivery
cards.text: Beans at your door in two days.
cards.backText: Order by noon and it ships the same day, in a bag that keeps the beans fresh for a month.

cards.title: Wholesale
cards.backText: Weekly deliveries, a grinder on loan and a morning of barista training for your staff.

cards.title: Tasting mornings
cards.text: Tap or click: this one ignores hover.
cards.backText: The first Saturday of each month, 9 to 11. Six coffees, one table, no booking needed.
